verdict.rationale: Cline's docs state that MCP lets it use external tools and data sources through MCP servers. The GitHub readme confirms you can manage MCP servers in the app, and auto-approve settings cover MCP tools, which shows MCP tool calls are part of the agent loop. missing for 10: detailed configuration docs (transport types, how servers are added or edited) in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of MCP use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers.
manage models, plugins, and MCP servers
Cline auto-approves everything: file changes, terminal commands, browser actions, MCP tools, and mode transitions.
